questions.stem: What is the role of the sinoatrial node (SAN) in the cardiac cycle?

options.text: It receives deoxygenated blood from the vena cava
It acts as the heart's natural pacemaker, generating electrical impulses
It prevents blood from flowing back into the atria
It pumps blood into the pulmonary artery

questions.explanation: The sinoatrial node (SAN) is the heart's natural pacemaker. It generates electrical impulses that spread across the atria, causing them to contract and initiating each heartbeat.
